description: Sales Forecasting Accuracy and Bias tracking sheet for Vietnam market, structured by Date, Entity (NW), and Variant (Total, Marlboro Red, Marlboro Gold, Marlboro Flavor Code). Contains actual sales figures benchmarked against monthly forecasts at two lag intervals: M-1 (one month prior forecast) and M-3 (three months prior forecast). For each lag interval, the sheet provides: Actual sales values, Plan forecasts, Sales Forecasting Accuracy (SFA) percentages, Bias percentages, Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), and Absolute Error metrics. Data enables month-on-month tracking of forecast accuracy degradation and systematic forecasting bias across product variants.
business_facts: Sales Forecasting Accuracy (SFA) - Measures alignment between actual sales and forecasted sales prepared at M-1 and M-3 intervals. SFA below 90% indicates forecasting inefficiency and should trigger investigation into demand planning processes. M-1 SFA reflects near-term forecast reliability; M-3 SFA reflects medium-term planning accuracy. Bias - Quantifies systematic over- or under-forecasting tendency. Positive bias indicates consistent overestimation of demand; negative bias reflects underestimation. Bias exceeding ±5% signals structural forecasting issues requiring corrective action. MAPE and Absolute Error provide complementary error metrics for root cause analysis. Variant-level breakdown enables identification of product-specific forecasting challenges. Entity field (NW) supports geographic or organizational segmentation. Trending across months reveals seasonal patterns and forecast model performance degradation over longer planning horizons.
